name: Inventec Corporation
summary: Inventec Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufacture, processes, and trades in computers and related products in Taiwan, the United States, Japan, Hong Kong, Macau, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through Core Department and Other Department segments. It offers personal systems, including notebook PC, desktop/AIO, and thin client products; and enterprise and cloud data center products, such as servers, blade servers, network switches, storage devices, rack solutions, and server management software, as well as storage server and network switch solutions. The company is also involved in the environmental energy and emerging technology businesses…
